facts.fact: AGER, under the STP Digital project, put the National Cybersecurity Strategy of Sao Tome and Principe 2024-2028 and its annexed action plan out for public consultation, inviting contributions by telephone and email within 30 days of publication (September 2025; the page is undated, so the date is the reported launch month).
